## BusinessDayAccountingCalendar

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.FinancialOperations.Reconciliation.BusinessDayAccountingCalendar</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.FinancialOperations/Reconciliation/BusinessDayAccountingCalendar.cs:10](../../../../src/Meridian.FinancialOperations/Reconciliation/BusinessDayAccountingCalendar.cs#L10).

The production IAccountingCalendar: a configurable weekend mask plus an operator-supplied holiday set. Period resolution follows the bank posting convention — a posting stamped on a weekend or holiday is recognized in the next business day&#x27;s accounting period. Dates are interpreted against the UTC timeline of the posting timestamp; deployments whose books close in a local market timezone pre-normalize timestamps before ingestion.

## AlpacaActivityStatementConnector

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.FinancialOperations.Reconciliation.Connectors.Alpaca.AlpacaActivityStatementConnector</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.FinancialOperations/Reconciliation/Connectors/Alpaca/AlpacaActivityStatementConnector.cs:18](../../../../src/Meridian.FinancialOperations/Reconciliation/Connectors/Alpaca/AlpacaActivityStatementConnector.cs#L18).

Alpaca account statement connector. Fetches activity (fills + cash transactions + dividend corporate actions) and portfolio state (positions + cash balance) through the registered Alpaca brokerage gateway, retains the combined snapshot as a JSON document, and parses that document into canonical records — so scheduled fetches, ad-hoc fetches, and re-imports of retained snapshots all share one parse path. Degrades to file-only when no Alpaca gateway is registered in the host.

## Bai2StatementConnector

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.FinancialOperations.Reconciliation.Connectors.Bai2.Bai2StatementConnector</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.FinancialOperations/Reconciliation/Connectors/Bai2/Bai2StatementConnector.cs:22](../../../../src/Meridian.FinancialOperations/Reconciliation/Connectors/Bai2/Bai2StatementConnector.cs#L22).

BAI2 (Cash Management Balance Reporting) connector. Reads the group as-of date and currency, each account&#x27;s closing ledger balance (status code 015), and every transaction-detail (16) record, signing amounts by BAI type-code class (100–399 credit, 400–799 debit). Amounts are expressed in the currency&#x27;s minor units (cents) per the BAI2 convention and scaled to major units. This lets institutional bank cash statements reconcile without hand-conversion to CSV.

## Camt053StatementConnector

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.FinancialOperations.Reconciliation.Connectors.Camt.Camt053StatementConnector</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.FinancialOperations/Reconciliation/Connectors/Camt/Camt053StatementConnector.cs:26](../../../../src/Meridian.FinancialOperations/Reconciliation/Connectors/Camt/Camt053StatementConnector.cs#L26).

ISO 20022 camt.053 (Bank-to-Customer Statement) connector. Ingests the closing booked balance and every booked entry from each Stmt, signing amounts by CdtDbtInd, so institutional bank cash statements reconcile without hand-conversion to CSV. The format carries fixed semantics, so it maps directly to canonical records rather than through a column mapping profile. XML is read with DTD processing prohibited and no external resolver to avoid XXE.
